steps: RRC Setup Request → RRC Setup → RRC Setup Complete
NAS Security Mode Complete + RRC Security Mode Complete
PDU Session Establishment Request → Accept (IP + DNS)
pass_criteria: All attach checklist steps found in log (see nr_sa_attach_checklist.json)
Registration Accept received
PDU session with assigned IPv4/IPv6
No Authentication failure or Registration reject
SCG active with NR leg
DL throughput on NR leg measurable
No SCG failure / split bearer drop

steps: Verify UE capability for CA combo
pass_criteria: Two DL CC active in UE report
Aggregated throughput > single carrier baseline
No SCell deactivation under stable RF

steps: gNB sends UE Capability Enquiry (filter RAT/container as needed)
UE responds with UE Capability Information
If capa > 9 KB: ULDedicatedMessageSegment until lastSegment
gNB configures CA/MIMO/bandwidth from bandCombinationList and featureSets
pass_criteria: Enquiry and Information both present in log
Target band/combo in supportedBandListNR or bandCombinationList
All segmentation segments received when capa is segmented
Network enables feature under test after capa exchange

preconditions: UE declares matching ue-PowerClass in capa
steps: Capture UECapabilityInformation — verify ue-PowerClass for target band
Configure cell for HPUE if network supports PC2/PC1.5
Drive or static test at cell edge — measure UL throughput vs PC3 baseline
Confirm max UL power ~26 dBm (PC2) or 29 dBm (PC1.5) per 38.101-1
pass_criteria: UE capa declares expected power class
Measured max UL power within spec tolerance
UL throughput gain vs PC3 at edge (typically 2–5 dB link margin)
No ACLR/spurious regression at elevated power

preconditions: UE and gNB in SA or NSA mode
Log capture covering attach or data session
steps: Scan log for layer keywords (RRC, NAS, PDCP, HARQ, SDAP/QFI)
Map failure to layer — RF (PHY) vs L2 (MAC/RLC) vs AS (RRC/PDCP) vs NAS/core
pass_criteria: Both planes understood for the test scenario
Failure localized to a single layer or interface
Relevant 3GPP spec identified (e.g. 38.331 RRC, 24.501 NAS)
Troubleshooting checks match layer (not treating NAS fail as RF-only)
Call setup < 3s
MOS acceptable / no drop during test window
Correct QCI/5QI for voice bearer
